results.title: Woman jumps into Chenab in Doda, search operation launched
results.description: A young woman allegedly jumped into the Chenab River from the Shiva Dal bridge near Prem Nagar in Doda district on Saturday afternoon, prompting an extensive search operation by the district administration and rescue teams. results.title: Who leaked America's weapons secrets? Pentagon subjects top military officials to polygraphs
results.description: Dozens of senior US military officials were subjected to polygraph tests in a sweeping investigation into media leaks involving classified information on America's stockpiles of advanced weapons.

results.title: Ganga breaches flood mark in Patna; 3.5L affected in UP
results.description: Owing to heavy rainfall, water level has risen in several rivers of Bihar and Uttar Pradesh, leading to flooding in several parts of the states. In Bihar, the Ganga river on Saturday breached the flood-level mark in Patna. results.title: Vijay hails role of teachers in shaping students, building social progress
results.description: In a message marking Teachers’ Day, CM Vijay said teachers played a crucial role in nurturing young minds, instilling values and preparing students to become responsible citizens capable of contributing to the country’s development.
